title: Ricardo Custódio
text:
Research


Digital Identity
Digital identity, authentication, authorization and verifiable credentials.


Digital Signatures
Electronic signatures, digital signatures, PKI and long-term validation.


Cryptography
Cryptographic algorithms, protocols and applied cryptography.


Finite Fields
Efficient arithmetic over binary finite fields and modular reduction.


Post-Quantum Cryptography
Cryptographic mechanisms and infrastructures for the post-quantum transition.


AI & Security
Artificial intelligence applied to security, identity and autonomous agents.


Electronic Documents
Electronic documents, long-term validation, preservation and trust infrastructures.


Information Security
Security architectures, protocols, infrastructures and trustworthy systems.


Explore my research →

title: Ricardo Custódio
text:
Current Research

Personal AI Agents — identity, authorization, accountability and non-repudiation for autonomous agents.
Digital Identity & Digital Signatures — infrastructures and protocols for trustworthy digital transactions.
Finite Field Arithmetic — efficient multiplication and modular reduction over binary extension fields.
Post-Quantum Cryptography — transition of digital-signature and trust infrastructures to post-quantum cryptography.
